turns.customer: My old boy Winston is on 4 meds, three times a day, some crushed into his food. What do you charge for that?
blocks:
Happy Tails’ published rate sheet doesn’t list a separate medication-administration charge, so I can’t quote one. Its policy says staff can administer oral or topical medications, but not injections; complex handling instructions may incur a fee. Prescription medications should stay in their containers with clear written directions and be kept separate from food.

Because Winston needs four medications three times a day, including some crushed into food, the specific fee for that schedule and food handling isn’t stated. Happy Tails staff can clarify at **(512) 764-6150**.
